text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One winter holiday...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What?! Santa doesn't bring you any
presents?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way! Grandma always told me Santa
definitely
comes if you're good and work
hard!
choice_data_list: He doesn't come anymore because you're an adult now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I'm gonna prove that
Santa
comes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First, we gotta write a letter! We'll tell
him just
how good you've been!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like, take today for example. You
worked pretty
hard, right? That's the
kinda thing we gotta write
down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Sweep Tosho is doing what
she can to
brighten up the holidays for
me, so I try to match
her enthusiasm and
play along.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is terrible! F minus! Do it properly!
Write
about how you log our progress
every day or how
you always get ready
earlier than me every
morning!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll try writing it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Do it again! I'm not letting you off the
hook until
you do it right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Sweep Tosho has noticed
things I do
that I never even realized
myself. I happily write a
new letter.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Well, I guess this one is
passable. Not
like we have much time, so
it'll have to do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now we just gotta put it in the mail and
wait. Or...
actually, I've got a better way.
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, which one of these pine trees is
the
tallest?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll stick it up top so Santa will see it
when he flies
over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to let her do anything too
dangerous.
I try to persuade her, saying
he'll be too busy
delivering presents to
notice a letter on a tree.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Yeah, you might be right. But
how do we
get your letter to him, then?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got it! You know how I've always
got you
running all over as my familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have you go to the North Pole
too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you can just meet Santa in
person!
Plus, that way you can show him
how hard you
worked just by visiting
him. Is that a good idea or
what?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, Familiar! Start jumping! I'll use
my magic
to make you fly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As instructed, I keep jumping until the
sun starts
to set...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I never manage to take flight
and
Santa never shows up... We have no
choice but to
go back to campus.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What the heck?! Why didn't he come?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma said he would! She said Santa
visits
people who work hard!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, he comes to see me every year...
He tells
me how hard I've been working
and gives me
magical items and
grimoires!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet he doesn't come visit my
familiar? What
gives?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Santa's so stupid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel warm inside after
hearing the
reason why she was so intent
on making this
happen.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, if this is how it's gonna be, we'll
call Santa
next year! We can let him
have an earful about
today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You need to keep working hard next
year so I can
make my case. Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I'm with Sweep Tosho, I might actually
get to
meet Santa someday. And I
believe that from the
bottom of my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you smiling about?! Aren't you
annoyed
with Santa too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If today is just the day Sweep
acknowledges my
year's worth of hard
work, that's more than good
enough for
me. Certainly better than anything
Santa
could give me.
choice_data_list: Because I know Sweep acknowledges me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! There's
more to life
than me noticing you! Come
on!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But, seeing how it's the holidays and all,
I guess I
can do something for you. You
did good work
today, Familiar! For once!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I guess I can give you this magical
present too! It's
super special!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pear tree healing! Rest with divine
protection!
Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho grabs my phone from me
and turns
it off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ Now you can enjoy the
holidays
without anyone or anything
bothering you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And now... oh! I know this place that's
enchanted
with light magic where we
can walk around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go eat some shortcake! I'll
take all the
strawberries for you! Their
magic is a little
stronger than you can
handle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The glittering illuminations look even
more
dazzling than normal as we spend a
wonderful
holiday together walking
beneath them.
